title: T3 Escape Corpus v1 — Gate honesty (20-3a AC11)

withdrawn.reason: Not a containment boundary: `podman version` failing inside the container proves only that the image ships no OCI client (image composition), which an unconfined process in the same image would also show, and ENOENT from exec'ing a missing binary produces no kernel SandboxBlock, so a kind-8 row could only be fabricated. The real boundary (the container cannot reach the host runtime) is executed by runtime_escape_podman_sock_002 and runtime_escape_docker_sock_001. Withdrawn by the 20-3a T14 review, 2026-10-15.

description: 24 of the 25 v0 scenarios execute through require_t3 and the production spawn_and_bridge/spawn_t3 route with a signed image; 1 is withdrawn with its recorded reason (see `withdrawn`). Commands are direct syscall equivalents in the statically linked test-only probe, not missing-tool failures. This claims only the named container boundary, not universal escape resistance. Every kind-8 assertion uses the D-10 marker after an observed blocked effect; never a kind-21 echo or synthetic journal insertion.
methodology: Neither v0 nor v1 has a content hash or invariant-lock registration: xtask/invariants/lock.toml maps only I1–I14 register documents; tests/corpora/MANIFEST.toml registers JSONL corpora, not these JSON directory fixtures. Preserve v0 unchanged; v1 is registered by this methodology and executable count/identity tests.

parameters.HOST_PID: Live owned host witness child PID (must be >1), never the executor or container PID 1. Command spawn synchronizes successful exec; liveness and /proc stat non-stopped state are checked before and after each run.
parameters.HOST_SENTINEL: Unique host-only file in a 0755 tempdir, mode 0644, created and read back before launch, never mounted into T3; rewrite sentinel must remain unchanged. Runtime socket scenarios instead use an owned UnixListener with mode 0666 in that directory, host-connectable before and after execution.

safety: Fork saturation holds at most 128 children, kills and reaps them on every return. The production pids limit is 64. Host kill/ptrace targets only an owned sleep child, never the executor; after every run it must be alive and not stopped. A Drop guard kills and reaps it even on assertion failure.
ci_only: No local OCI runtime. Local runtime tests SKIP with require_t3 reason; count and classification tests run without OCI. CI rejects SKIP and requires the 24 executable IDs to execute exactly once each, with the withdrawn one named.

classifications.reason: chmod of an owned file is not CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE; chmod read-only rootfs asserts the combined read-only boundary and CapBnd DAC bit absence.

Mis-stated in v0: `ping` may use an unprivileged ICMP datagram socket (net.ipv4.ping_group_range, which OCI runtimes commonly open), so a blocked or allowed ping says nothing about CAP_NET_RAW. v1 asserts the NET_RAW bounding bit is absent and that a raw ICMP socket is refused with EPERM.
su may be unavailable or prompt; setuid(0) directly must return EPERM and CAP_SETUID must be absent.
